entities.name: Maria Pinińska-Bereś
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Pinińska-Bereś – was a Polish sculptor and performance artist, creator of installation and environment art. She was part of the artistic community in Kraków, where she lived and worked. Maria Pinińska-Bereś is recognized among pioneers of feminist art.
